scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.cutout:install: npm run cutout:build && install -m 755 apps/cutout-cli/.build/release/cutout /usr/local/bin/cutout && cutout --version
scripts.release:preflight: npm run release:project && app-release --config apps/native-macos/release/macos.json --mode preflight
scripts.release:screenshots: npm run release:project && app-release --config apps/native-macos/release/macos.json --mode screenshots
scripts.release:videos: npm run release:project && app-release --config apps/native-macos/release/macos.json --mode videos
scripts.release:media: npm run release:project && app-release --config apps/native-macos/release/macos.json --mode screenshots && app-release --config apps/native-macos/release/macos.json --mode videos
